CITY COUNCIL

January 03, 2024, 7:00 PM

  NOTICE OF MEETING
  CANCELLATION

  OF THE FOLLOWING:
  REGULAR MEETINGS OF THE CITY COUNCIL

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting
of the City Council of the City of Baldwin Park scheduled for
Wednesday, December 20, 2023 and January 3, 2024, has been
CANCELLED.

  Said meeting was to be held in the Council Chambers,
  14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park CA, at 7:00 pm.

  The Next Regular Meeting of the City Council is scheduled for
  Wednesday, January 17, 2024, at 7:00 pm, Council Chambers,
14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park, CA.

  Notice of Cancellation was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.
  Dated this 12th day of December 2023

  Shirley Quiñones,
  Chief Deputy City Clerk
